The '''Jmin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Jmin Survival Academy]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jmin system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-16.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
